watermarking_standard.rule: Every simulated or fallback mock record is strictly tagged with is_demo=True and watermark='DEMO DATA'. In production live tenant mode, seed mock records are never mixed into live tables.
ui_indicators: data-testid='demo-data-watermark' banner in inquiries and partner dashboard
data-testid='detail-demo-watermark' in detail drawer of PartnerInboxView

negative_abuse_guardrail.rule: Under live network outages (connection drop, HTTP 502/503/504, timeout), the platform NEVER fabricates success or pretends a transaction went through.
negative_abuse_guardrail.enforcement: Frontend client and backend service fail closed with typed NetworkOutageError / ApiError, displaying explicit error alert banners, keeping submissionResult strictly null, never generating phantom reference codes (INQ-XXXX), and refusing to synthesize fake status.
